name: Jellyfin
description: Stream your movies, shows and music to any device. Uses the phone's hardware video encoder.
install:
apk add --no-cache jellyfin jellyfin-web
# Hardware encoding: Jellyfin's V4L2 option is routed to Android's MediaCodec by the
# ffmpeg shim. Only on first install, so a user's own choice is kept.
mkdir -p /var/lib/jellyfin/config
[ -e /var/lib/jellyfin/config/encoding.xml ] || cat > /var/lib/jellyfin/config/encoding.xml <<'XML'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<EncodingOptions xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <HardwareAccelerationType>v4l2m2m</HardwareAccelerationType>
  <EnableHardwareEncoding>true</EnableHardwareEncoding>
</EncodingOptions>
XML
# Torrent downloads show up in Jellyfin: a "Downloads" library (mixed movies and shows,
# watched for new files) once both apps are installed. Only once, so a user who
# removes the library in Jellyfin keeps it removed.
if [ -x /usr/bin/jellyfin ] && [ -x /usr/bin/qbittorrent-nox ] && [ ! -e /var/lib/jellyfin/.downloads-library ]; then
  mkdir -p /media/Downloads /var/lib/jellyfin/root/default/Downloads
  cd /var/lib/jellyfin/root/default/Downloads
  printf /media/Downloads > Downloads.mblink
  cat > options.xml <<'XML'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LibraryOptions xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <Enabled>true</Enabled>
  <EnablePhotos>true</EnablePhotos>
  <EnableRealtimeMonitor>true</EnableRealtimeMonitor>
  <EnableLUFSScan>false</EnableLUFSScan>
  <EnableChapterImageExtraction>false</EnableChapterImageExtraction>
  <ExtractChapterImagesDuringLibraryScan>false</ExtractChapterImagesDuringLibraryScan>
  <EnableTrickplayImageExtraction>false</EnableTrickplayImageExtraction>
  <ExtractTrickplayImagesDuringLibraryScan>false</ExtractTrickplayImagesDuringLibraryScan>
  <PathInfos>
    <MediaPathInfo>
      <Path>/media/Downloads</Path>
    </MediaPathInfo>
  </PathInfos>
  <SaveLocalMetadata>false</SaveLocalMetadata>
  <EnableAutomaticSeriesGrouping>true</EnableAutomaticSeriesGrouping>
  <EnableEmbeddedTitles>false</EnableEmbeddedTitles>
  <EnableEmbeddedExtrasTitles>false</EnableEmbeddedExtrasTitles>
  <EnableEmbeddedEpisodeInfos>false</EnableEmbeddedEpisodeInfos>
  <AutomaticRefreshIntervalDays>0</AutomaticRefreshIntervalDays>
  <SeasonZeroDisplayName>Specials</SeasonZeroDisplayName>
  <DisabledLocalMetadataReaders />
  <DisabledSubtitleFetchers />
  <SubtitleFetcherOrder />
  <DisabledMediaSegmentProviders />
  <MediaSegmentProviderOrder />
  <SkipSubtitlesIfEmbeddedSubtitlesPresent>false</SkipSubtitlesIfEmbeddedSubtitlesPresent>
  <SkipSubtitlesIfAudioTrackMatches>true</SkipSubtitlesIfAudioTrackMatches>
  <RequirePerfectSubtitleMatch>true</RequirePerfectSubtitleMatch>
  <SaveSubtitlesWithMedia>true</SaveSubtitlesWithMedia>
  <DisabledLyricFetchers />
  <LyricFetcherOrder />
  <CustomTagDelimiters>
    <string>/</string>
    <string>|</string>
    <string>;</string>
    <string>\</string>
  </CustomTagDelimiters>
  <DelimiterWhitelist />
  <AutomaticallyAddToCollection>false</AutomaticallyAddToCollection>
  <AllowEmbeddedSubtitles>AllowAll</AllowEmbeddedSubtitles>
  <TypeOptions />
</LibraryOptions>
XML
  touch /var/lib/jellyfin/.downloads-library
fi

name: qBittorrent
description: Torrent client. Downloads go to the media library's Downloads folder, in order (stream while downloading), and keep seeding. Add from SSH: torrent 'magnet:?…'
install:
apk add --no-cache qbittorrent-nox curl jq
mkdir -p /media/Downloads /var/lib/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/config
# Only on first install, so the user's own settings are kept.
[ -e /var/lib/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/config/qBittorrent.conf ] || cat > /var/lib/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/config/qBittorrent.conf <<'CONF'
[LegalNotice]
Accepted=true

[BitTorrent]
Session\DefaultSavePath=/media/Downloads
Session\TempPathEnabled=false
Session\GlobalMaxRatio=-1
Session\GlobalMaxSeedingMinutes=-1
Session\QueueingSystemEnabled=false

[Preferences]
WebUI\Port=8081
WebUI\LocalHostAuth=false
CONF
cat > /usr/local/bin/torrent <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
# torrent <magnet or .torrent URL>...   add, downloading pieces in order
# torrent list                          show progress
api=http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/v2
if ! curl -fsS -o /dev/null "$api/app/version" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo 'qBittorrent is not running: start the server in the Homedroid app.' >&2; exit 1
fi
case $1 in
''|-h|--help) sed -n '2,3s/^# //p' "$0"; exit 2 ;;
list) curl -fsS "$api/torrents/info" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.progress * 100 | floor)%\t\(.state)\t\(.name)"'; exit ;;
esac
for link do
  curl -fsS -F "urls=$link" -F sequentialDownload=true -F firstLastPiecePrio=true "$api/torrents/add" >/dev/null &&
    echo "Added: $link"
done
SH
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/torrent
# Torrent downloads show up in Jellyfin: a "Downloads" library (mixed movies and shows,
# watched for new files) once both apps are installed. Only once, so a user who
# removes the library in Jellyfin keeps it removed.
if [ -x /usr/bin/jellyfin ] && [ -x /usr/bin/qbittorrent-nox ] && [ ! -e /var/lib/jellyfin/.downloads-library ]; then

  cat > options.xml <<'XML'

name: Home Assistant
description: Home automation hub. Network and cloud integrations work; USB radios and Bluetooth need root.
install:
apk add --no-cache python3 uv ffmpeg libjpeg-turbo libstdc++ tzdata ca-certificates
# proot fakes hard links, which uv's cache linking can't cope with; copy instead.
export UV_LINK_MODE=copy
rm -rf /opt/homeassistant /root/.cache/uv
uv venv --python /usr/bin/python3 /opt/homeassistant
uv pip install --python /opt/homeassistant/bin/python --index-strategy unsafe-best-match --extra-index-url https://wheels.home-assistant.io/musllinux-index/ homeassistant
mkdir -p /var/lib/homeassistant
